candidate_program.name: turnaround_weight_pressure
candidate_program.rationale: Balances reward against aggregate active rival weight and continuous turnaround occupancy. Uses native root and neighborhood inputs without added features; summed rival weight can overstate competing opportunity.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) * (1 + duration) / (1 + duration + 0.25 * (station_gap + satellite_gap))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
